summaryZh: Displacement and Health Research Center 研究流离失所作为健康社会决定因素的影响。中心旨在生成证据支持临床照护、公共卫生干预和政策，并让有亲身经历的社区参与问题、方法和方案的形成。在具体项目中，团队分别采用Google Earth Engine回溯环境暴露量化、BPCARE随机对照试验及社区参与的定性研究。
researchQuestions: 气候相关暴露如何影响在圣地亚哥重新安置的叙利亚难民的心血管健康？
圣地亚哥的阿拉伯难民如何看待认知老化、记忆丧失和痴呆风险？
难民营经历如何影响圣地亚哥阿拉伯、东非和阿富汗老年难民的认知？
methods: Google Earth Engine回溯暴露量化（气候暴露与心血管健康项目）
随机对照试验（BPCARE难民高血压自我管理项目）
社区参与的定性研究（加州痴呆移民照护项目）

evidence.quote: The Displacement and Health Research Center
We focus on studying displacement as a social determinant of health
The center is a one of a kind at UC San Diego
ensuring that those most affected by displacement help shape the questions, methods and solutions.
This study examines how climate-related exposures influence cardiovascular health among Syrian refugees resettled in San Diego.
This exploratory study investigates how Arab refugees in San Diego perceive cognitive aging, memory loss, and dementia risk.
In collaboration with the ARCH Network at UC San Francisco, this study examines the ways encampment experiences influence cognition among Arab, East African, and Afghan older refugees in San Diego.

This study examines how climate-related exposures influence cardiovascular health among Syrian refugees resettled in San Diego. Because many refugees traveled through multiple countries before arrival, the team uses Google Earth Engine to retrospectively quantify exposure to dust, pollutants, drought severity, and environmental hazards across their migration trajectories.
evidence.provenanceNote: 中心项目Climate-Related Exposures and Cardiovascular Health的team使用Google Earth Engine回溯迁移轨迹暴露。 项目页未提供此段方法采用的独立日期；不声明结果。

evidence.quote: BPCARE is the first randomized controlled trial ever conducted exclusively among refugee populations and is funded by the National Heart, Lung and Blood Institute. The project is carried out in partnership with a Federally Qualified Health Center and numerous community organizations. It evaluates the feasibility of at-home blood pressure monitoring and patient-centered education as tools to improve hypertension control.
evidence.provenanceNote: 仅BPCARE项目随机对照试验和可行性评价；不采first ever为新颖性结论，不声称降压疗效已证实。 同页提及未来扩大试验；原文当前试验与未来计划分开。

evidence.quote: Funded through the California Department of Public Health, this project is part of a statewide consortium dedicated to improving dementia care for migrant communities. It examines the health service experiences, long-term support needs and care pathways used by migrants living with dementia and their families. The project uses a qualitative, community-engaged approach to identify gaps and to develop community-informed strategies that can guide future health policies and create more equitable systems of dementia support across California.
evidence.provenanceNote: 仅California Department of Public Health支持的移民痴呆照护项目采用qualitative, community-engaged approach。 无独立方法日期或完成结果声明。
